events.factual_description: NJPAC presents The Dizzy Gillespie All-Stars at Bethany Baptist Church in Newark on Saturday, November 7, 2026 at 6:00 PM as a free Jazz Vespers concert within the TD James Moody Jazz Festival. The program is a tribute to Newark jazz legend James Moody. NJPAC identifies the ensemble as led by Dizzy Gillespie's longtime bassist John Lee, with Diego Urcola on trumpet, Don Braden on saxophone, Alex Collins on piano and Karl Latham on drums. The concert is co-sponsored with Bethany Baptist Church Jazz Vespers.

en.why_it_matters: This is lineage rather than costume. John Lee spent years inside Dizzy Gillespie's music, and the All-Stars put that vocabulary in service of James Moody — another musician whose bebop language was inseparable from both Dizzy and Newark. Moving the tribute into Bethany Baptist's Jazz Vespers gives the music a community and spiritual setting instead of turning it into a repertory exercise on a concert-hall stage.
en.trip_verdict: Actively make room for it if the Newark/NYC corridor is already in play, especially if bebop lineage and living transmission matter more than star billing. The church setting and direct Gillespie connection make it unusually meaningful, but I would not build a separate long-distance trip around this one concert alone.

es.why_it_matters: Aquí hay linaje, no disfraz. John Lee pasó años dentro de la música de Dizzy Gillespie, y los All-Stars ponen ese vocabulario al servicio de James Moody —otro músico cuyo lenguaje bebop estuvo íntimamente ligado tanto a Dizzy como a Newark. Llevar el homenaje al Jazz Vespers de Bethany Baptist le da a la música un contexto comunitario y espiritual en vez de volverla un simple ejercicio de repertorio en una sala de conciertos.
es.trip_verdict: Sí le haría espacio activamente si Newark/NYC ya está dentro del recorrido, sobre todo si importa más el linaje bebop y su transmisión viva que el puro cartel de estrellas. La iglesia y la conexión directa con Gillespie hacen la fecha especialmente significativa, pero no armaría un viaje largo exclusivamente alrededor de este concierto.
